COURSE TITLE    FOUNDATIONS OF MACHINE LEARNING
COURSE CODE     04BA0501
COURSE CREDITS  3

Objective:
 1 N/A


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Build an understanding of the basic concepts, types, and challenges in machine learning.
 2  Apply regression and classification models for predictive analytics.
 3  Evaluate and improve the model, performance using resampling and regularization
     techniques.
 4  Develop tree-based and support vector machine models for business decision- making.
 5  Apply unsupervised learning techniques like PCA and clustering in real-world scenarios.


Pre-requisite of course:Basic knowledge of statistical concepts.

                        Teaching and Examination Scheme
 Theory      Tutorial      Practical   ESE    IA    CSE     Viva     Term
  Hours      Hours       Hours                               Work
     3            0            0        50     30      20        0          0

 Contents :                                                             Contact                                       Topics    Unit                                                          Hours
     1      Unit 1: Foundations of Machine Learning in Business          10
               Introduction to Machine Learning, Learning Systems and Real-
             world ML Applications, Importance of ML in Business Analytics,,
              Variable Types and Terminology, Function Approximation,
             Concept of Learning and Types of Machine Learning, Curse of
              Dimensionality, Bias-Variance Tradeoff, Overfitting and
               Underfitting,, Model Selection Techniques, No Free Lunch
            Theorem
     2      Unit 2: Predictive Modeling ± Regression and Classification     9
              Linear Regression, Simple Linear Regression,, Model Accuracy: R²,
               Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Bayes
            Theorem, Naïve Bayes Classifier
     3      Unit 3: Resampling, Regularization, and Tree-Based           10
            Techniques
           Model Evaluation and Resampling Methods,, Cross-Validation:
          LOOCV, k-Fold, The Bootstrap Method,, Principal Component
             Regression (PCR),, Decision Trees for Classification and
              Regression, Advantages and Disadvantages of Decision Trees,,
            EnsembleMethods: Bagging, Random Forest, Boosting
